theorems.name: Submission.frt_cnm_exists_uniform_densityRatio_lower
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (x : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < t → HasDensity n μ x t → ∃ m k : ℕ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) → (2 * ((m : ℝ≥0∞) + 1))⁻¹ ≤ densityRatio n μ x ρ
